verdict.rationale: Mollie documents a dedicated Webhooks API with a next-gen 'permanently subscribe to specific event types' model, HMAC signature verification for security, and a Webhook Events API for retroactive inspection; the MCP server also exposes Webhooks/Webhook Events as callable tools for AI agents. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs and no explicit example of an AI agent programmatically registering a webhook subscription end-to-end.
